subject: Supplier payments: capture banking & invoice submission preferences
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Martinez <alicia@evergreentech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Supplier payments: capture banking & invoice submission preferences

Hi Alicia,

Welcome — excited to get Evergreen Tech set up with Redwood. I'm kicking off the vendor onboarding for payments and PO flow so our Finance and Procurement teams can process your first invoice smoothly. To keep things moving, can you confirm the following and return the attached onboarding form?

- Preferred payment channel: ACH (USD) or wire? If wire, please note we require SWIFT/BIC and intermediary bank details.
- Remittance email(s) where paid invoices should be sent (we post payments + remittance to this address).
- Legal company name exactly as it should appear on the vendor record and W-9/TIN.
- Invoice submission method: emailed PDF to ap@evergreentech.com, via portal, or via SFTP?
- Any PO requirements (PO number placement on invoice, vendor-specific line items).

Attachments: Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (fillable) — please complete and return. We also need a copy of your W-9 (or W-8 if non-US). Once we receive the form and W-9, Finance will create a vendor record and issue a Redwood PO for the first scheduled payment. Typical payment terms we use are Net30 unless otherwise agreed — we can confirm if Evergreen prefers different terms.

If you prefer a quick call to walk through the form, I can loop in Ben (Finance) and Laura (Procurement) — what time works?

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (fillable PDF), W-9_Request.pdf (template)

From: Alicia Martinez <alicia@evergreentech.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Evergreen Tech AP <ap@evergreentech.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Supplier payments: capture banking & invoice submission preferences

Hi Neha — thanks for the note and the warm welcome. Quick answers below and I'm attaching a couple of items so you can get started.

- Preferred payment channel: ACH (USD) is preferred for US payments. We can accept wire for international transfers.
- Remittance email: ap@evergreentech.com (this is monitored by our AP team).
- Legal name: Evergreen Tech, Inc. (EIN: 12-3456789)
- Invoice submission: Please email invoices to ap@evergreentech.com. We do not currently use a supplier portal.
- PO requirements: Please include the PO number on the top-right of the invoice and one line per invoice item with quantity and unit price.

I have attached: signed Vendor_Onboarding_Form (filled), a bank letter (redacted account number), and our W-9. Let me know if you need a voided check or micro-deposit test for ACH verification.

Best,
Alicia
Operations Director
Evergreen Tech

Attachments: signed_onboarding_form.pdf, bank_letter.pdf (bank letter confirming account ownership), W-9_EvergreenTech.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Alicia Martinez <alicia@evergreentech.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 08:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Supplier payments: capture banking & invoice submission preferences

Thanks Alicia — and thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple internal notes /asks from Finance: 

- For ACH: we need either a voided check OR the bank letter you attached plus a short bank confirmation (on bank letterhead) showing the account name and last 4 digits. We redact full account numbers in our records.
- Please confirm whether Evergreen is set up to receive remittance notifications (we send a remittance email once payment posts). If your AP team requires remittance in a particular format (CSV vs PDF), send the spec.
- Invoice header: Redwood requires invoice to reference the PO exactly (example: PO# RWD-2026-XXXXX). We will issue a PO once vendor ID is created in Coupa — expected lead time 2 business days after we receive onboarding docs.

Neha/Laura: I'll start the vendor creation once onboarding & W-9 are stored. Alicia, we'll aim to process first payment on Net30 terms — if Evergreen needs Net45 or earlier payment for onboarding, let me know and I can route for approval.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Alicia Martinez <alicia@evergreentech.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Evergreen Tech AP <ap@evergreentech.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 10:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Supplier payments: capture banking & invoice submission preferences

Thanks Ben — attaching the bank letter from First Harbor Bank (covering account name and last 4 digits). We can also provide a voided check if needed. Remittance format: PDF remittance is preferred; we can accept CSV if Redwood needs automated posting — sample CSV spec attached here (see bank_letter.pdf for now).

On postal/legal address and invoice header: please use the legal name (Evergreen Tech, Inc.) and remit-to as: 212 Commerce Blvd, Suite 200, Portland, OR 97205.

PO number format is noted — please send the Coupa vendor ID and PO once created. We prefer ACH and will confirm micro-deposit testing if Redwood requires it.

Regards,
Alicia

Attachments: bank_letter.pdf, W-9_EvergreenTech.pdf

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Martinez <alicia@evergreentech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Supplier payments: capture banking & invoice submission preferences

Alicia — thanks, got everything and uploaded to the vendor intake queue. Next steps: 

1) Finance will run onboarding checks and create the vendor record in Coupa by EOD Monday (Dec 7). You'll receive a Coupa vendor ID and we will issue the first PO (format RWD-2026-XXXXX).
2) Payment terms: default Net30. If Evergreen needs alternative payment terms for the initial invoice, reply and we'll evaluate (may require AP approval).
3) ACH setup: we'll perform the micro-deposit test (one or two small deposits) to the account provided; please confirm when you have visibility so we can complete verification.
4) Remittance: Redwood will send paid remittance to ap@evergreentech.com in PDF format. If you later want CSV, share the spec and we'll see if we can automate it.

Ben/Laura: please proceed with vendor creation and let me know if you need a voided check or more supporting docs.

Thanks again — looks straightforward. Alicia, once you receive the Coupa vendor ID please confirm and we'll mark onboarding complete.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference
